:count budgetposter gäller andra räkensk: :count budget records are for other fiscal years than the file's and are not read in. Read in the budget for another year with that year's file.
Budgeten i filen (#PBUDGET) läses inte i: The budget in the file (#PBUDGET) is not read in, but the bookkeeping is: :problems
Lägger till årets budget, den som använd: Adds the year's budget, the one used in the reports, to the SIE file. Without the tick the file holds only the bookkeeping.
Rad :line: objektkoden \":code\" är läng: Line :line: the object code ":code" is longer than 20 characters.
:count konton och månader får en rad uta: :count accounts and months get a line without cost centre and project for what is on no object, for example account :account :month with :amount.
På :count konton och månader saknar file: On :count accounts and months the file lacks the account's whole amount ({}) but has both cost centres and projects. The larger of the two sums is taken as the account's amount.
Filen har en budget, men du har inte beh: The file has a budget, but you are not allowed to make budgets, so it is not read in.
Filens budget är inläst som en ny budget: The file's budget has been read in as a new budget with :count lines.
Filen har en budget, men du har inte beh: The file has a budget, but you are not allowed to make budgets, so it was not read in.
Läses inte in, se Bra att veta: Not read in, see Good to know
:lines rader på :accounts konton, blir e: :lines lines on :accounts accounts, becomes a new budget
Filen har budget men inget räkenskapsår: The file has a budget but no fiscal year (#RAR 0).
Rad :line: budgetmånaden :period ligger: Line :line: the budget month :period is outside the fiscal year.
The budget on account :accounts is not read in. Budgets here are for profit and loss accounts (3000–8998).
Budget per dimension :dimensions läses i: The budget per dimension :dimensions is not read in. Budgets here are per cost centre (1) and project (6); the account's whole amount is read in anyway.
:count budgetposter anger mer än ett obj: :count budget records give more than one object, which the format does not have. They are not read in; the account's whole amount is read in anyway.
Filen är av SIE-typ 2, som inte har budg: The file is of SIE type 2, which has no budget per object. :count budget records with objects are therefore not read in.
Kvantiteter i budgeten läses inte in, ba: Quantities in the budget are not read in, only amounts.
På :count konton och månader har budgete: On :count accounts and months the budget has both cost centres and projects. SIE gives them separately, so the budget is read in per cost centre and per project, with a line without objects that makes the account's total match.
Rad :line: budgetmånaden \":period\" går: Line :line: the budget month ":period" cannot be read. It should be written YYYYMM.
Rad :line: budgetens konto \":account\": Line :line: the budget's account ":account" does not have four digits.
Rad :line: budgetbeloppet för konto :acc: Line :line: the budget amount for account :account cannot be read.
Rad :line: budgeten för konto :account o: Line :line: the budget for account :account and the month :period is already on line :first.
Filen har bara budget för andra räkenska: The file only has a budget for other fiscal years than its own (#RAR 0).
Filen saknar kontrollsumma, så det går i: The file has no control sum, so it is not possible to tell whether it has been changed on the way.
Filen är av SIE-typ :type, som inte har: The file is of SIE type :type, which has no budget. Produce a file of type 2, 3 or 4.
Filen gäller organisationsnummer :theirs: The file is for organisation number :theirs, but this company has :ours. Read the budget in to the right company.
Räkenskapsåret :start – :end finns inte: The fiscal year :start – :end does not exist here. Create it under Fiscal years, or read in the whole SIE4 file under Read in SIE file.
Konto :accounts finns inte i kontoplanen: Account :accounts is not in the chart of accounts here. Add the accounts under Chart of accounts and check the file again.
Kostnadsställe :codes finns inte här. Lä: Cost centre :codes does not exist here. Add it under Cost centres and projects and check the file again.
Projekt :codes finns inte här. Lägg till: Project :codes does not exist here. Add it under Cost centres and projects and check the file again.
Filen är för stor. Den får vara högst 12: The file is too large. It may be at most 12 MB.
Filen är granskad, men budgeten kan inte: The file has been checked, but the budget cannot be read in as it is. See what needs correcting.
Filen är granskad. Läs igenom rapporten: The file has been checked. Read the report and then read in the budget.
Budgeten är inläst som en ny budget med: The budget has been read in as a new budget with :count lines.
Läs in budget från SIE-fil: Read in budget from SIE file
Budgeten (#PBUDGET) i en SIE-fil av typ: The budget (#PBUDGET) in a SIE file of type 2, 3 or 4 becomes a new budget for the file's fiscal year. The bookkeeping in the file is not read in; you read that in under Read in SIE file.
Budgeten kan inte läsas in som den är: The budget cannot be read in as it is
Budgeten blir ett utkast som du kan ändr: The budget becomes a draft you can change. It is used in the reports only if the year does not already have a budget that is.
